messages:
deploy-bot: Started deployment to dedicated/private-prod by @maya — tag v2.4.7-rc3 (commit abc1234) — change window 03:00-04:00 UTC
maya: initiating canary rollout (2 instances) and watching dashboards
deploy-bot: Canary step 1/5: provisioning canary instances... done
deploy-bot: Canary step 2/5: starting services on canary-1, canary-2
jon: quick Q — is the model-serving runtime pinned for this canary?
maya: yes pinned to runtime v1.12. We did not change quantized-ops in this tag
sre-oncall: attaching quick health check — p95 latency on canary-1 = 300ms, ok so far
deploy-bot: Canary health probe @ 60s: ok on canary-1 & canary-2
paul: rolling to 20% next if no regressions
deploy-bot: Canary step 3/5: increasing traffic to 20% (4/20 instances)
sre-oncall: seeing error spike on canary-1: 5xxs rising, investigating
sre-oncall: tailing logs from canary-1 -> ```2026-03-18T03:18:22Z ERROR kv-cache: OOM while reserving block (step=87)
stack: ...```
liz: ugh, kv-cache OOM again, maybe memory compaction not applied in this build
jon: could be config mismatch — are evictions disabled?
maya: checking rollout config... can confirm eviction policy is default, but rc3 included a cache refactor
sre-oncall: metric alert triggered: canary-1 p95 = 1200ms (threshold 500ms) -> status CRITICAL
deploy-bot: Canary healthcheck FAILED (policy: any canary failure)
maya: aborting further rollout. proposing immediate rollback to v2.4.6
jon: +1 — pin to v2.4.6 across dedicated/private to stop flapping
paul: creating incident ticket and assigning to eng-runtime, linking logs
paul: ticket RED-1234 created: https://redwood.atlassian/browse/RED-1234
deploy-bot: Initiating rollback to tag v2.4.6 (commit def4567) per rollback policy
deploy-bot: Draining canary traffic and moving all routing to v2.4.6...
sre-oncall: verifying health post-rollback — starting health probes
d eploy-bot: NOTE: rollout policy applied: immediate rollback due to canary failure
deploy-bot: Rollback completed — environment=dedicated/private-prod final_tag=v2.4.6 duration=6m36s
maya: acknowledged. will update release notes (changelog + known issue) and pause the release train
liz: adding notes: cause likely kv-cache refactor memory regression, will add to postmortem
jon: follow-up action: add a canary-only flag to disable the new kv-cache by default -> safer testing
maya: opened PR to add canary-disable flag: https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/789
paul: please add regression test and memory pressure e2e for canaries
deploy-bot: Deploy finished — status=rolled_back environment=dedicated/private-prod initiated_by=maya
maya: thanks all, will ping customers in change window if needed and schedule a deeper postmortem tomorrow :thumbsup:
